MY OWN DEFECT, FOUND BY THE FIRST RUN AND FIXED. Run 32407365014 @ 7e8cfff: security SUCCESS, daemon FAILURE, control-room SKIPPED, supply-chain SKIPPED. GitHub's default step condition is `success()`, so a red step skips every later step — one red erased two populations' evidence, which is the exact absence this job exists to remove.
